# Intuitech Fantasy (league-2) -- Monday Briefing, Week 7

**Week 6 is closed for this roster** (13 of 14 games played; only tonight's SF@WAS Monday-nighter remains, and no rostered player is on either team). This briefing pivots straight to **Week 7**.

## Source and freshness

**Live, but early in the week.** Ran `generate_report.py` myself end-to-end (`--week 7 --scoring-config leagues/league-2/scoring-config.json --skip-rotowire --skip-news`) because the committed Week 7 fixture predates the season (generated 2026-09-08). The live run used real 2026 game logs through Week 6, the current schedule and depth charts, and the fitted availability/calibration/blend pipeline (blend active for QB/RB/TE/WR). ESPN, Sleeper and Rotowire are proxy-blocked in this sandbox as expected, and no FantasyPros key is set, so this is the in-house tier throughout -- but critically, **no Week 7 injury or practice report exists anywhere yet**, confirmed with a direct `load_injuries(2026, week=7)` call returning 0 rows. That's a timing fact (teams file Wed/Thu), not a sandbox limitation. Every 'Healthy' tag below means unfiled, not cleared.

## Start these ten

| Slot | Player | Opp | Expected pts | P(play) | If he plays |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| QB | Matthew Stafford | @LV | **16.90** | 97.0% | 17.43 |
| RB | Jonathan Taylor | vs MIN | **16.36** | 95.2% | 17.19 |
| RB | Bucky Irving | vs CAR | **13.95** | 95.2% | 14.66 |
| WR | Jaxon Smith-Njigba | @KC (SNF) | **21.23** | 96.8% | 21.94 |
| WR | Drake London | @SF | **16.13** | 96.8% | 16.67 |
| TE | Isaiah Likely | vs HOU | **15.44** | 94.7% | 16.30 |
| FLEX | Tee Higgins | vs BAL | **13.59** | 96.5% | 14.08 |
| FLEX | Jalen Coker | @TB | **13.34** | 94.5% | 14.12 |
| K | Dominic Zvada | vs HOU | **8.13** | 98.5% | 8.25 |
| DEF | **Vikings D/ST (WAIVER TARGET)** | @IND | **11.67** | 100% | 11.67 |
| **Total** | | | **146.74** | | |

*(Total assumes the Vikings D/ST claim lands -- see Changes below. Without it, the real total is 135.07 with an empty DEF slot.)*

Bench: Sam LaPorta TE (12.13), Jameson Williams WR (10.31), Cam Skattebo RB (10.26), Tyler Shough QB (17.04, no slot behind Stafford), TreVeyon Henderson RB (6.17). IR: Jaxson Dart QB.

Only one real judgment call: **QB is a coin flip.** Shough actually edges Stafford by 0.14 expected points (17.04 vs 16.90) -- well inside this model's noise floor. Held Stafford rather than flip the lineup on a gap smaller than the model's own error.

## Changes since Saturday's briefing (Week 6, total 143.72)

- **Pivoted to Week 7** -- Week 6 is done for this roster.
- **Higgins in, Skattebo out at FLEX** (+3.33 exp). Higgins is back from CIN's bye and clears Skattebo (13.59 vs 10.26).
- **LaPorta back from DET's bye but stays benched.** Isaiah Likely still outprojects him at TE, 15.44 vs 12.13 -- no change to the TE slot despite the starter's return.
- **Jameson Williams also back from bye, still benched** -- lowest of the five flex-eligible WR/TE options this week (10.31).
- **DEF is the headline issue**: Jaguars D/ST (the only rostered DEF) hits its bye this week, and there's no bench D/ST. Recommending a waiver claim on Minnesota (11.67 exp @IND, the best Week 7 matchup leaguewide).

## Watch list

| Item | Why | When |
|---|---|---|
| **Vikings D/ST waiver claim** | DEF slot is empty without it this week. | Before Wednesday 10/21 processing |
| **Week 8 kicker bye** | NYG (Zvada's team) is on bye Week 8, and there's no backup K rostered. Also takes bench Shough, Skattebo and Likely out the same week. | Start scouting a K streamer now, claim before Week 8's deadline |

## Opponent notes

- Jaxon Smith-Njigba draws Sunday Night Football @KC -- locks last among this roster's games, so it's safe to leave for last if anything else is still in flux.
- The recommended DEF target, Minnesota, happens to play Jonathan Taylor's Colts -- no roster conflict, just the matchup that makes MIN the best streaming option.

## Byes ahead

- **Week 7 (now):** Jaguars D/ST -- see Changes/Watch List above; needs an immediate waiver replacement.
- **Week 8:** A full NYG bye-week cluster -- Dominic Zvada (the only rostered K), plus bench Tyler Shough, Cam Skattebo and Isaiah Likely, plus IR'd Jaxson Dart. Five of fifteen rostered players, one team. The kicker hole is the one that actually forces a move (no backup K); the rest are bench players with no immediate lineup impact, but plan the waiver wire now rather than the week it hits -- five bench spots don't stretch far against a cluster this size.

## Caveats

- No Week 7 injury/practice data exists anywhere yet (confirmed directly, not a sandbox artifact) -- every designation above is 'unfiled,' not 'cleared.'
- The committed Week 7 fixture is pre-season (2026-09-08) and was disregarded; its conditional-points numbers differ from this live run by over 100% for most players, which is the fixture's age showing, not an error in either run.
- Lineup total (146.74) assumes the Vikings D/ST waiver claim succeeds; the real total with the Jaguars D/ST on its bye is 135.07.
- Snap-share data didn't load (DynastyProcess crosswalk is 403 in this sandbox); the rest of the blend (rolling volume, Vegas totals) loaded fine.
- QB call (Stafford over Shough) is a 0.14-point coin flip, held rather than flipped, consistent with how this series has handled similarly thin edges before.
